decisions.reason: Because it closely extends the firm’s existing automation and infrastructure know-how, the company’s strong in-house R&D and research links give it high absorptive capacity to refine the offering from early project experience rather than exit quickly.

As a digital engineering tool that fits the firm’s established planning and software modules, it is highly related to existing knowledge and can be improved efficiently through customer feedback and the firm’s research capabilities.

This product builds directly on the firm’s established heat-exchanger and monitoring competence, and given the firm’s broad solution portfolio, proprietary development base, and university cooperation, management would be likely to retain it and learn its commercial potential further.
